title: Hoagland and Flynn hold joint conferences on the Mars ruins

tellings.quote: And in fact, Richard Hogland would did a series of conferences with David Flynn

plain: Richard Hoagland, a writer known for claiming there are ruins on the surface of Mars, held a series of conferences together with another writer named David Flynn. A researcher named Tim Alberino mentions this in passing, without naming a source, while talking about the people who promoted the idea of ancient structures on Mars.
